agent_priors_used: Benchmark arms whose correctness is already at ceiling cannot establish a treatment advantage; dynamic range must be certified on the comparator before spending an expensive run (agent prior; consistent with the recorded bounded substrate-class negative EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440, not independently re-established here).

For small, well-structured binding vocabularies a deterministic lexical resolver with an explicit abstention signal can match or beat learned embeddings, and calibrated selective abstention - not raw selection accuracy - is usually the binding constraint for safe deployment (agent prior).

A bounded positive from a single vantage/condition should be re-tested on the orthogonal axis (independent source vantage) before being treated as a general property; if that orthogonal axis is unavailable, the result keeps its declared scope boundary (agent prior).

Long-horizon agents are generally more robust when they persist procedures/mechanisms and re-observe volatile values than when they persist exact state, because transport- and context-coupled values drift faster than mechanisms (agent prior; SPIDER's value-persistence negative is consistent with but does not prove this).

A capable model runtime is a prerequisite that cannot be discovered by re-running benchmark arms; the correct first step is a minimal capability probe, and if none can be provisioned the blocker must be recorded as an exact operational receipt rather than substituted (agent prior).

A both-directions falsifier that can return a clean bounded negative is worth more than another positive refinement; re-running the same sampling-frame precondition without changing the measured object is a design defect being repeated, not a second experiment (agent prior).

allocation.question: Given that a bank-blind, model-free deterministic operation-synonym + resource-noun resolver already exceeds max-cosine embedding selection for unseen-goal mechanism identity on the frozen 113-goal primary set (97/113=0.8584 vs 78/113=0.6903; paired family-blocked 95% bootstrap diff -0.1681, CI [-0.3077,-0.0268]) while both the two-feature cosine/margin logistic gate and the single global cosine threshold collapse to GATE-NOT-MET (t*=1.0, coverage 0.0), does a model-free resolver whose OWN ambiguity/coverage signal (e.g. unresolved operation synonym, tied/absent resource-noun match, missing required slot) supplies the abstention decision simultaneously reach pooled false-accept <= 0.10, coverage >= 0.50 and unknown-precision >= 0.85 on a disjoint calibration/test split, and does that deterministic resolve()+ambiguity-gate pair retain its selection advantage on a held-out mechanism set and under a differently curated synonym lexicon -- thereby deciding whether resolve() ships as a deterministic resolver plus ambiguity gate with the embedding path retired, or whether unseen-goal resolution must move to a structured slot/parameter or retrieval-model architecture trained on independently authored goals?
allocation.rationale: Graph is IDLE and must be reactivated. The lane's last finalized transaction (EXP-GRAPH-38175554380, audit PASS, bounded measurement-valid) established the selection half of the question and explicitly left the abstention/calibration half unmeasured: the deterministic resolver's selection advantage is real on this fixture but no identified gate exists, so the product cannot yet ship resolve() with a safe UNKNOWN. Decision counterfactual: if the deterministic resolver + own-signal gate reaches FA<=0.10 / coverage>=0.50 / unknown-precision>=0.85 on a disjoint split and holds on a held-out mechanism set and alternate lexicon, the embedding path is retired and a deterministic resolver ships; if the gate collapses again, the decision is to move unseen-goal resolution to a structured slot/parameter or retrieval-model architecture. Both branches change a concrete product decision, so the experiment is decision-bearing rather than a continuation-by-inertia. Feasibility is high (fixture-level stdlib-local HTTP, no credentials/browser/model), which is why this is the right graph claim now versus the substrate-heavy C-DELTA-REPAIR (last attempt MEASUREMENT_INVALID on distributed substrate reliability) and C-FRESHNESS (four-anchor D1V route explicitly parked by the global audit). Smallest decisive batch: one frozen experiment with a disjoint calibration/test split, a held-out mechanism set and a second synonym lexicon; stop trigger: if the gate is again never identified (coverage 0.0) on the deterministic resolver's own signal, terminate the embedding-vs-deterministic subthread and re-allocate graph to structured resolution or to a neglected inheritance claim.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: All six lanes get decision-relevant work; none is parked. Product/Runtime/Intel form the critical path to the gated flagship benchmark and each is on one of the three audit-documented blockers: Product continues the B1 shipped-carrier positive/negative certificate (C-PARAM-INHERIT, pre-freeze EXP-PRODUCT-38170378449); Runtime completes the already-FROZEN B2 asymmetric-discovery task-bank dynamic-range certificate (C-MEAS-VALID substrate work, EXP-RUNTIME-38169622704); Intel continues the B3 capable-endpoint search or exact credential blocker (C-LLM-INHERIT readiness, pre-freeze EXP-INTEL-38175568787). The other three lanes are independent but not idle. Graph is reactivated on C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE because the just-finalized bounded result (deterministic resolver beats embedding on unseen-goal mechanism identity, but no identified abstention gate: t*=1.0, coverage 0.0) leaves a sharp product architecture decision untested: ship deterministic resolve()+ambiguity gate with the embedding path retired, or move to a structured slot/retrieval architecture. Physics continues the only recently valid positive's named scope boundary: cross-vantage transfer of intrinsic access-barrier persistence and denylist validity (pre-freeze EXP-PHYSICS-38121193195), with a loud-fail branch if no second independent egress can be provisioned. Frontier continues the redesigned C-CROSSSITE discovery-attainability question (pre-freeze EXP-FRONTIER-38164611798), whose both-directions falsifier directly prices the persistence thesis: O(1) discovery-enabled acquisition means path persistence buys nothing structural; path-bound acquisition exposes a computable amortization surface. No expensive four-arm flagship execution (C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON) is funded this cycle: the three readiness conditions are not jointly satisfied in accepted evidence (the shipped treatment carrier is not yet installed at the shipping kernel path, the task bank certificate is still in flight, and no capable same-protocol endpoint has cleared the minimal capability probe). The current allocations remove those blockers rather than re-running invalid benchmark packets. Budget stance: each active allocation is a single bounded pre-freeze/frozen transaction with a both-directions decision rule; no tunneled family receives a further experiment beyond its current mandate, and the C-FRESHNESS four-anchor D1V route stays parked per the global audit.
